'''Michelle''' (Japanese: '''ミシェル''' ''Michelle'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG043|Let Bagons Be Bagons]]''.

While on their way to [[Fallarbor Town]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} noticed a {{p|Bagon}} trying to jump off a cliff. As it turned out, the Bagon belonged to Michelle. She informed Ash and the others that it was determined to fly. To help support Bagon's dream, Michelle had built a special set of computer analysis glasses so it could evolve into a {{p|Salamence}} as soon as possible.

Upon hearing this, Ash challenged Michelle in a {{pkmn|battle}}. During the battle, Michelle's glasses helped Bagon land direct hits and evade {{AP|Pikachu}}'s own attacks. However, {{TRT}} interrupted the match, kidnapping Bagon for {{an|Giovanni|their boss}}. In the process, they assisted Bagon in achieving its dream with their jet pack. Michelle assisted Ash in recovering Pikachu from the trio, as she maneuvered Bagon's new jet pack with the dropped remote control. Afterwards, Michelle and the others watched as Bagon evolved into {{p|Shelgon}}.

Michelle later agreed to battle {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Pikachu}}. However, the match was interrupted when {{MTR}} swooped in with a jet pack and stole Bagon. During the ensuing confrontation, [[Jessie]] dropped the jet pack remote, which caused the jet pack to go haywire, sending Meowth and Bagon flying off into the distance. After crashing-landing, Bagon realized the jet pack could help it fly and kept using it. Ash and the others located Bagon again, and it teamed up with [[Ash's Treecko]] to rescue Pikachu in an aerial pursuit. After Pikachu's rescue, Bagon [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Shelgon, leaving it only a step away from developing wings.

Shelgon's only known move is {{m|Headbutt}}.}}
